title: PixelKin - A Trainer Spots You (get ready)
_note: The LOOPING body of trainer-eyes: 8 bars of 4/4 at 152 BPM (~12.6 s), played under the trainer's walk-up and challenge lines until the battle theme takes over. A natural minor with a harmonic-minor E dominant - the battle cues' own key (dusk-duel and emberfall are both A minor), so the hand-off to the fight lands in the same tonal room. Chords Am F G E | Am F Dm E; bar 8 sits on E to slam back into the Am downbeat. The hook opens with the Vesper rising leap in its battle treatment (E-A-B: the lift overshoots the tonic and the settle is withheld), restless and bright on a pulse lead; a sixteenth broken-chord arp, a pumping root-fifth bass, brass stabs on 1 and the and-of-2 ('get-ready' hits) and a driving beat with fills on bars 4 and 8. Tight and urgent but light - a dare, not a threat. Original (VISION.md).
